name: Robe of the Overflowing Spirit, Fire
body:
Price 8,000 gp; Aura moderate Evocation; CL 7th; Slot body; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This robe shines with a vibrant orange sheen, its cloth constantly moving and flowing, even when there is no air to jostle it.

The wearer deals an additional 1 point of fire damage on all attacks. Wearers with the spirit ability can access additional powers when they gain spirit in excess of their normal maximum capacity. When this happens, the robe consumes the extra spirit points, and the wearer may activate the ability as a free action, otherwise the points are wasted. For every point of spirit consumed by this robe, the wearer gains a +3 bonus on all damage rolls for 1 round.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 4,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells produce flame
